name: WeWork
one_liner: WeWork provides flexible, move-in ready office spaces and coworking memberships for businesses and individuals.
what_you_sell: Flexible workspace solutions including private offices, coworking memberships, meeting rooms, and enterprise space management technology.
target_group: WeWork sells flexible workspace solutions to mid-sized growing businesses, enterprise companies, and remote-first teams. They target Heads of Real Estate, Workplace Experience Managers, and Operations Directors who need adaptable office space without committing to long-term commercial leases. A strong prospect is a business undergoing geographic expansion or shifting to a hybrid work model.
b2c_note: While individual freelancers can purchase coworking memberships, the high-value paying side consists of business organizations purchasing dedicated offices and enterprise real estate solutions.
who_uses_it: Employees, distributed teams, freelancers, and business professionals needing daily workspace or meeting facilities.
who_pays_for_it: Company operations leaders, real estate heads, HR leaders, or individual business owners.
who_buys_it: Heads of Real Estate, Chief Operations Officers, Workplace Managers, and Chief People Officers at businesses seeking flexible physical footprint.
_claims_to_check: Operates 600+ locations across 30+ countries and 100+ cities
Provides access to 2,000+ partner locations globally
Manages 45M square feet and serves 550K members
Saves real estate costs while offering custom space management technology
